audience: church staff and volunteer coordinators who run their church with Elvanto

useCases.title: Review service rosters, plans and songs
useCases.text: The AI lists upcoming services with the volunteer roster, the order of service and songs, so you see who serves and what is planned.

useCases.title: Find people by name, email or flag
useCases.text: The AI searches people by fields such as name, email, phone, volunteer or category, and opens one person with extra fields.

useCases.title: See who is waiting in a follow-up flow
useCases.text: The AI lists people flows, their steps, and the people in one step with status, due date and assigned admin. You see who still needs a follow-up.

useCases.title: Look up small groups and calendar events
useCases.text: The AI lists small groups with meeting day, time and place, with members and leaders if you ask, and calendar events between two dates.

useCases.title: Add a guest to a follow-up flow or small group
useCases.text: The AI adds a person to the church database, then puts them into a people-flow step or a small group.

useCases.title: Review giving transactions by fund
useCases.text: The AI lists giving transactions between two dates, for one fund or all, with donor, date, method and amounts, and sums them up. It only reads.
